To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
character level convolution networks are a promising alternative for text classification, especially when the vocabulary size is large and the data is sparse.

(i) character level convolutional neural networks could be a competitive approach to traditional text classification methods; (ii) they can achieve state of the ar t or comparable performance to word based ConvN ets; (iii) they can outperform traditional text classification models such as bag-of-words and n-gram models; and (iv) they can achieve comparable results to recurrent neural networks.
Character level ConvNets can be used to classify text with state of the art accuracy.
